sloka: ह्रियमाणाम् तु वैदेहीम् दृष्ट्वा दीनो दिवाकरः ।प्रविध्वस्त प्रभः श्रीमान् आसीत् पाण्डुर मण्डलः ॥३-५२-३८॥
transliteration: hriyamāṇām tu vaidehīm dṛṣṭvā dīno divākaraḥ ।pravidhvasta prabhaḥ śrīmān āsīt pāṇḍura maṇḍalaḥ ॥3-52-38॥

translations.english: Seeing Sita abducted, the glorious Sun looked lustreless and distraught. He developed a pale white disk around him.
